_comment: Backlog of mashup themes for the Daily Large (15x15). Each theme lists entries as [ANSWER, clue sketch]. Validated by scripts/seedgrid/check-themes.mts: lengths must pair under rotational symmetry (plus at most one centered odd entry), no two entries share a letter run longer than 3, nothing over 15. 'status' is set by the checker.
